findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_video, start_legacy_story · Private data: run_template, create_image, create_video, start_legacy_story · Public sink: check_legacy_story, check_story_video, fruit_story_guide, start_fruit_story, create_upload_link, suggest_template · Destructive: run_template, get_run, story_video_guide, start_story_video, get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_video, start_legacy_story · Private data: run_template, create_image, create_video, start_legacy_story · Public sink: check_legacy_story, check_story_video, fruit_story_guide, start_fruit_story, create_upload_link, suggest_template · Destructive: run_template, get_run, story_video_guide, start_story_video, get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "run_template" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
